newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium launches EU treaty review.
newsitem.headline: Belgium launches EU treaty review.

text.p: With the European Union less than a week away from wrapping up A lengthy review of its Maastricht treaty, Belgium has chosen to launch what amounts to a referendum on the bloc's future.
The first stage of the two-part campaign, consisting of leaflets, posters and postcards covering European security, employment and social aspects of the bloc, starts on Wednesday.

People will be able to use the postcards to write to the government letting it know their views on the state and future of the 15-nation EU, whose summit meeting in Amsterdam on June 16 and 17 is due to conclude the first rewrite of Maastricht.
Later in the year the second stage of the campaign will start, including discussions with activists and interested parties from firms to unions and students.

The government will then merge the results of the postal replies and the discussions to formulate its policy on Europe for the next review of the Maastricht treaty, the Federal Information Service said.
